article.title: Virginia hosts Delaware in Week 4
article.story: Delaware (2-1) at Virginia (2-1), Sept. 26 at 6 p.m. EDT. Opening Line: Virginia by 20.5. Against the spread: Virginia 2-1, Delaware 3-0. How to watch: ACC Network Key stats Virginia Offense Overall: 411 yards per game (66th in FBS) Passing: 193.7 yards per game (101st) Rushing: 217.3 yards per game (34th) Scoring: 40 points per game (28th) Virginia Defense Overall: 276 yards per game (32nd in FBS) Passing: 150 yards per game (19th) Rushing: 126 yards per game (69th) Scoring: 16.3 points per game (34th) Delaware Offense Overall: 426.7 yards per game (57th in FBS) Passing: 325.7 yards per game (11th) Rushing: 101 yards per game (130th) Scoring: 30 points per game (77th) Delaware Defense Overall: 317.7 yards per game (61st in FBS) Passing: 223.3 yards per game (87th) Rushing: 94.3 yards per game (27th) Scoring: 18.7 points per game (50th) Virginia is 115th in third down percentage, converting 34.2% of the time. Delaware ranks 61st on defense, holding its opponents to 34.9%. Virginia is 11th in the FBS with a +4 turnover margin. Delaware ranks 9th in the FBS averaging 32.7 penalty yards per game. Virginia is 81st in FBS in red zone offense, scoring on 84.6% of trips. Delaware's red zone defense ranks 10th at 62.5%. Virginia ranks 24th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 33:08. Team leaders Virginia Passing: Beau Pribula, 514 yards, 7 TDs, 1 INT, 72.4 completion percentage Rushing: Jekail Middlebrook, 154 yards on 35 carries, 1 TD Receiving: Dashawn Martin, 87 yards on 3 catches, 2 TDs Delaware Passing: Nick Minicucci, 814 yards, 5 TDs, 3 INTs, 57.9 completion percentage Rushing: Jo'Nathan Silver, 156 yards on 33 carries, 1 TD Receiving: Sean Wilson, 288 yards on 18 catches, 3 TDs Last game Virginia fell 38-27 to West Virginia on Sept. 19. Pribula passed for 197 yards on 21-of-33 attempts (63.6%) with two touchdowns and no interceptions. Middlebrook had 75 rushing yards on 17 carries and one touchdown, adding two receptions for one yard and one touchdown. Xay Davis recorded 51 yards on three catches. Delaware won 22-14 over Coastal Carolina on Sept. 19. Minicucci passed for 302 yards on 24-of-32 attempts (75.0%) with two touchdowns and no interceptions. Viron Ellison Jr. carried the ball six times for 30 yards. Wilson recorded 185 yards on nine catches with two touchdowns. Next game Virginia plays at Florida State on Oct. 3. Delaware hosts Liberty on Oct. 2.
